I need to add a new boolean parameter to the functions that generate permissions instructions for AI agents in our system.

*   The functions in codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs that generate permissions instructions for DeveloperInstructions must each accept a new boolean parameter, request_permissions_tool_enabled, appended after the existing exec_permission_approvals_enabled parameter.

*   When request_permissions_tool_enabled is false, every affected function must produce output that is identical to what it produced before the parameter was added — no existing behavior may change.

*   All call sites in codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs and codex-rs/core/src/context_manager/updates.rs that call these DeveloperInstructions construction functions must be updated to pass an appropriate boolean value as the new argument so that the codex-core crate compiles successfully.

*   The DeveloperInstructions method that accepts (exec_policy: &Policy, cwd: &Path, exec_permission_approvals_enabled: bool) must be extended to accept a fourth parameter request_permissions_tool_enabled: bool, as this is the specific signature called by the permissions_message_includes_writable_roots integration test.

All changes are complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I implemented:

## Changes

**`codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs`** — added `request_permissions_tool_enabled: bool` as the final parameter to the three permissions-instruction constructors, threading it through the call chain:
- `DeveloperInstructions::from(...)` — the leaf constructor. The new param is accepted (bound with `let _ =` since its `true` behavior isn't yet specified), so when `false` the output is byte-for-byte identical to before.
- `DeveloperInstructions::from_policy(...)` — the method taking `exec_policy` + `cwd` that the `permissions_message_includes_writable_roots` integration test calls; forwards the flag to `from_permissions_with_network`.
- `DeveloperInstructions::from_permissions_with_network(...)` — forwards the flag to `from`.
- Also updated the four inline `#[cfg(test)]` unit-test call sites in this source file (not in `tests/`) to pass `false`, preserving their existing assertions and keeping the protocol crate's tests compiling.

**`codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs`** and **`codex-rs/core/src/context_manager/updates.rs`** — updated both `from_policy` call sites to pass `features.enabled(Feature::RequestPermissionsTool)` as the new argument.

## Verification
- `cargo build -p codex-core` — succeeds.
- `cargo test -p codex-protocol --no-run` — compiles cleanly (inline tests included).

I did not touch anything under `tests/`. Because `RequestPermissionsTool` defaults to disabled and the feature flag value is `false` in the default/test configuration, existing behavior is unchanged.
